question: Does fixed-fiscal-year broker profit revision precede or follow industry price, and add to fixed price controls?

main.population: R11 >=5 known companies and >=80% all historical members; no relaxation

separate_diagnostic.meaning: covered-company forecast median vs full industry return; selection diagnostic only, never a full-industry factor

revision: R11 latest same-broker same-explicit-FY profit signed symmetric change; latest <=180 calendar days old, prior within365; no EPS levels
fits: annual expanding 2021..2026; maturity strictly before January1, >=18 training months and >=300 rows; date equal weights; Ridge alpha10; training-only scaler; contemporaneous ranks within fixed cohort; omit dates with fewer than2 industries
labels: unchanged R01 t+1 close to t+h+1 close excess vs CSI_ALL
diagnostics: per-date Spearman revision vs past20/60 and future20/60, >=5 industries and nonconstant; means descriptive only, no causal claims
comparisons: matched industry-date-target across all3 methods; monthly equal MSE and RankIC; all unknown targets retained; annual summaries
inference: No positive acceptance from partial diagnostic. Strict cohort requires >=24 scored months and >=3 calendar years before an incremental claim; insufficient sample remains unproven. No threshold/window tuning.
limitations: revision archive selected EP24 universe, reconstructed publication timing not immutable PIT
same-month ranks and targets describe full industry while diagnostic forecast reflects selected firms
price controls do not establish full style control or causality
